column1: # p576 / 576-B — can this harness reach a government or IGO primary?  Answer: no, as a CLASS.
# Channel A: curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://<host>/   (000 = no connection)
# Channel B: WebFetch, which reports getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for the same hosts.
# The LAST ROW IS A FABRICATED CONTROL and it answers IDENTICALLY, so the verdict carries
# no information about whether the host exists.  575-C's "fetch the primaries" is unexecutable.
